{# Header version switcher styled like pydata-sphinx-theme's built-in one, populated from sphinx-multiversion's git-derived `current_version`. #} {%- macro version_label(name) -%} {{ name[8:] if name.startswith("release/") else name }} {%- endmacro -%} {#- `current_version` is only present under sphinx-multiversion; a plain single-version build (make html) has none, so fall back to a "dev" label for local previews. -#} {%- set label = version_label(current_version.name) if current_version else "dev" %} {#- Always emit the button: pydata drops navbar items that render empty. -#}
{%- if versions %} {%- for item in (versions.branches + versions.tags) | version_sort %} {{ version_label(item.name) }} {%- endfor %} {%- endif %}
